messages:
Alex Kim: Quick report — our quickstart SPA crashed when a user navigated mid-stream. Error was `Unexpected end of JSON input`. Repro: start streaming, press Back quickly. Browser gives a final partial chunk.

Priya Desai: That's the classic partial-chunk + non-streaming decoder problem. Are we using `TextDecoder.decode(chunk)` per chunk in the sample?

Alex Kim: yes, sample does per-chunk decode + immediate JSON.parse. Two things I saw in traces: (1) multi-byte chars split across chunk boundaries (emoji/CJK) => decode breaks, (2) auth proxy sometimes injects HTML 401 mid-stream which gets appended and then parsed.

Mark O'Neill: Proposed fixes: 1) switch sample and SDK to `const decoder = new TextDecoder(); decoder.decode(chunk, {stream:true})` and only call `decoder.decode()` without stream at the end; 2) normalize CRLF: `text = text.replace(/\r\n/g,'\n')` before splitting; 3) split on event delimiter (e.g. `\n\n`) and only JSON.parse complete frames; 4) if stream closes with leftover, emit `stream_incomplete` diag with base64 payload; 5) surface final `status` + `headers` when non-200 body appears so apps can detect auth HTML.

Priya Desai: Also: default `autoRetryStreaming` should be `'none'`. If teams want resume they must opt into `resumeFrom(token)` and server must support a resume window. We'll add a one-line quickstart note: "Cancel streams on navigation (AbortController + onpopstate) and prefer streaming TextDecoder + delimiter parsing."

Alex Kim: I'll open a tiny PR to update the quickstart sample and attach a short repro gist (ETA: today).

devex-bot: Created ticket INF-2401 "quickstart: streaming partial-chunk, CRLF, and auth-mid-stream handling" and assigned Alex, Priya, Mark.
